name: Candlestick
overview: The candlestick, as detailed in Exodus 25:31-36, is a divinely ordained piece of furniture crafted from pure gold with intricate designs including six branches, bowls shaped like almonds, knops, and flowers. This single, beaten work of art was made according to God's precise pattern for the Tabernacle, symbolizing both divine craftsmanship and holiness. Its detailed construction underscores its sacred purpose and significance in worship.
